title: Release eve 0.6.0
summary: Prepared the eve 0.6.0 release by updating npm installer metadata and moving the accumulated changelog notes into a dated 0.6.0 release section.
userVisibleChange: eve 0.6.0 is ready for tagged deployment with release notes covering live dashboard refreshes, merged-branch pending Snapshot resolution, required agent Plan declaration, shorter generated agent guidance, and the eve UI title rename.

risks.title: Deployment depends on remote GitHub Actions and npm credentials
risks.mitigation: The local release was verified before tagging; pushing v0.6.0 will trigger the configured Release workflow, which requires repository secrets such as NPM_TOKEN.

timeline.title: Locked release plan
timeline.summary: Declared and locked the EVE plan for preparing and deploying eve 0.6.0.

timeline.title: Prepared release metadata
timeline.summary: Ran scripts/prepare-release.sh 0.6.0 with RELEASE_DATE=2026-07-28 after adding release notes.

timeline.title: Ran release verification
timeline.summary: Ran local release verification and the docs site build successfully.

timeline.title: Ready for tag deployment
timeline.summary: The implementation commit is ready to be tagged v0.6.0 and pushed to trigger the release workflow.

decisions.title: Use the existing tag-driven release workflow
decisions.rationale: The repository release workflow publishes GitHub assets and the npm installer from pushed v*.*.* tags, so the local preparation focused on version metadata, changelog, verification, and tag deployment.

decisions.title: Include the production-generated site type reference
decisions.rationale: The CI-equivalent docs build updates the tracked Next type reference to .next/types/routes.d.ts, so the release commit includes that generated tracked change.

validation.output: Passed after rerunning outside the sandbox so Go, npm, and Xcode could use their normal build caches. Covered go test ./..., CLI version injection test, npm installer tests, npm pack dry run for @nhestrompia/eve@0.6.0, UI tests/build, and macOS approval app test/build.
Next.js 16.2.10 production build compiled, typechecked, and generated 20 static pages successfully.
